name: Counselor
overview: Scripture reveals that true counsel is rooted in God's wisdom and character, as exemplified by the title 'Counselor' given to Christ in Isaiah 9:6, highlighting His divine guidance and authority. The Psalms caution believers to avoid the counsel of the ungodly (Psalms 1:1) while embracing God's testimonies as their trusted advisors (Psalms 119:24). Proverbs 1:5 emphasizes the value of wise counsel for growing in understanding, and Isaiah 28:29 affirms that God's counsel is both wonderful and effective. Prayerful dependence on the Lord invites His responsive guidance, as shown in Isaiah 58:9.
